decision: Do not run an invented partial baseline. Checkout lacks several directly imported local modules and README method C is not dispatched. Remaining code expects image arrays/PIL, image datasets/ResNet and CUDA; faithful tabular MLP port requires substantial reconstruction. Use requested explicit related-work distinction instead.
method_difference: FedCBDR globally coordinates class-level replay construction and changes logit/objective balancing; our allocator uses only local prior memory plus current fitting rows and adds no allocation-related communication.
